name: Castle courtyard
desc: the working yard inside the walls, where arrivals, drills and departures happen
tags: castle courtyard, worn stone flagstones, curtain wall on all sides, crenellated battlements, arched gatehouse, iron portcullis, wooden well, hay cart, straw on the ground, banners on poles
prose: a walled castle courtyard paved with worn stone flagstones, a crenellated curtain wall closing it on every side, an arched gatehouse with an iron portcullis, a wooden well and a hay cart against the wall, banners hanging from poles
note: Renders as an open stone plaza with no sense of enclosure. The curtain wall and battlements on the FAR side of frame are what make it a courtyard instead of a street - keep them in shot. It also drifts to spotless heritage-site stone; the well, the cart and straw on the flagstones put it back in a working period.
